# TD Direct Investment — How to import trades from  TD Direct Investment into TradeZella using the file upload method?

Source: https://help.tradezella.com/en/articles/6791045-td-direct-investment-how-to-import-trades-from-td-direct-investment-into-tradezella-using-the-file-upload-method

TradeZella supports importing trades from TD Direct Investment using three different file formats. For a successful import, ensure the header of your exported file matches one of the provided formats. Below are the instructions to guide you through the process:



## Exporting trade data from TD Direct Investment into a file

- Login to TD Advanced Dashboard

Login to TD Advanced Dashboard

- Access Historical Orders

Access Historical Orders

- Click on Historical Orders.

Click on Historical Orders.

- Choose Custom Date Range.

Choose Custom Date Range.

- The initial date should be the account’s inception date. Go as far back as the system allows, and set the end date to today’s date.

The initial date should be the account’s inception date. Go as far back as the system allows, and set the end date to today’s date.

- Select YES under Order Detail.

Select YES under Order Detail.

- Export as CSV

Export as CSV

- Click on the gear icon next to Account Detail and select Export List as CSV.

Click on the gear icon next to Account Detail and select Export List as CSV.



## Uploading the exported file into TradeZella

- Visit the TradeZella Add Trade page here or by clicking the “Add Trade” button on the sidebar.

Visit the TradeZella Add Trade page here or by clicking the “Add Trade” button on the sidebar.

- On the Add Trade page, click “Add New Account” if you’re creating a new account for these trades.

On the Add Trade page, click “Add New Account” if you’re creating a new account for these trades.

If you’re uploading trades to an existing account, simply click on the “Add Trades” button in the account field:

- On the Add New Account page, select TD Direct Investment as the broker and click Continue.

On the Add New Account page, select TD Direct Investment as the broker and click Continue.

- Next, select the File Upload method and click Continue again.

Next, select the File Upload method and click Continue again.

- On the final step, select the timezone of the file and upload the file. The system will handle the rest.

On the final step, select the timezone of the file and upload the file. The system will handle the rest.



## Supported File Formats

For a seamless import process, make sure your file headers match one of the three supported formats. Refer to the attached files and screenshots to verify the correct format.

- First Supported File Format:Ticker | C | Action | Qty | Prc Info | Bid | Ask | Duration | Status | Modifications | Avg Fill Price | Rem. Qty | Order Date | Quote Trend | Price | Change | % Chg | Rel Range | Vol | Avg Vol 6M | Blk Vol | High | Low | Open | Close | Trend

First Supported File Format:

Ticker | C | Action | Qty | Prc Info | Bid | Ask | Duration | Status | Modifications | Avg Fill Price | Rem. Qty | Order Date | Quote Trend | Price | Change | % Chg | Rel Range | Vol | Avg Vol 6M | Blk Vol | High | Low | Open | Close | Trend



- Second Supported File Format:Account | Strategy | Security Type | Reference Number | Action | Symbol | Quote | Price | Price Terms | Good'til | Order Date | Fill Status | Fill Quantity | Original Quantity | Avg Fill Price | Shareholder Status | Multi-Leg Net Fill Price | Dividend Option | Amount (including commission) | All or None

Second Supported File Format:

Account | Strategy | Security Type | Reference Number | Action | Symbol | Quote | Price | Price Terms | Good'til | Order Date | Fill Status | Fill Quantity | Original Quantity | Avg Fill Price | Shareholder Status | Multi-Leg Net Fill Price | Dividend Option | Amount (including commission) | All or None



- Third Supported File Format:Ticker | Action | Qty | Avg Fill Price | Status | Modifications | Prc Info | Bid | Ask	Price | Duration | Account Number | Date & Time | Rem. Qty | C

Third Supported File Format:

Ticker | Action | Qty | Avg Fill Price | Status | Modifications | Prc Info | Bid | Ask	Price | Duration | Account Number | Date & Time | Rem. Qty | C



By following these steps, you can efficiently import your trades from TD Direct Investment into TradeZella. Make sure to check that your file headers align with one of the supported formats for a successful import. Happy trading! 🚀
